Figure 4B

color_func_blue <- colorRampPalette(colors = c("#C6DBEF", "#075a84")) # myC
color_func_orange <- colorRampPalette(colors = c("#F3E55C", "#E8602D","#67000d")) # yellow to orange to red   fap mes adi
color_func_green <- colorRampPalette(colors = c("#a6dbbb", "#2e7651")) # vC
color_func_purp <- colorRampPalette(colors = c("#edbbcb", "#62376E")) # lyC
color_func_grey <- colorRampPalette(colors = c("#D3D3D3", "#636363")) # other

depots_STx <- readRDS("data/depots_STx.RDS")

results <- depots_STx@meta.data[,123:182]

Deconvolution_df <- depots_STx@meta.data[,63:122]

results_long <- results %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = contains("_score"),  # Adjusts to include all cell types
    names_to = "cell_type",
    values_to = "homotypic_score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(cell_type = str_remove(cell_type, "_score"))

results_long = results_long[!is.nan(results_long$homotypic_score)&!is.na(results_long$homotypic_score),]
results_long = results_long[results_long$homotypic_score>0,]

results_long_new <- data.frame()
for (i in unique(results_long$cell_type)){
  temp <- results_long[results_long$cell_type==i,]
  set.seed(0605)
  temp <- temp[sample(1:nrow(temp),size = 1000),]
  results_long_new <- rbind(results_long_new,temp)
}

results_long <- results_long_new

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(0605)  # You can choose any number as a seed

# Random shuffle
results_long <- results_long[sample(nrow(results_long)),]


results_long <- results_long %>%
  mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = colnames(Deconvolution_df))) %>%
  arrange(cell_type)

results_long$order <- 1:nrow(results_long)

# Compute center position for each cell_type
type_centers <- results_long %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(center = median(order))

# Join centers back to the original data
results_long <- results_long %>%
  left_join(type_centers, by = "cell_type")




## Plot lymphoid cells
results_long_ly <- results_long[grep(pattern = "ly|B_cell|Plasma_cell",results_long$cell_type),]

results_long_ly$order <- 1:nrow(results_long_ly)

number <- 0
for (i in unique(results_long_ly$cell_type)){
  results_long_ly$order[results_long_ly$cell_type==i] <- results_long_ly$order[results_long_ly$cell_type==i] + number *1000
  number <- number + 1
}

# Compute center position for each cell_type
type_centers <- results_long_ly %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(center = median(order))

# Join centers back to the original data
results_long_ly <- results_long_ly %>%
  left_join(type_centers, by = "cell_type")

p1_temp_ly <- ggscatter(data = results_long_ly,x = "order",y = "homotypic_score",color = "cell_type",size = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = type_centers$center[1:55], labels = type_centers$cell_type[1:55]) +  # Custom labels
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,vjust = 0.5,hjust = 1),aspect.ratio = 0.5448141,
        legend.position = "none") +  # Rotate x-axis labels for readability
  ylim(0,0.009) +
  labs(x = "Cell Type",
       y = "Homotypic Score",
       title = "lymphoid") +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_func_purp(n = unique(results_long_ly$cell_type)%>%length())) +
  NoAxes()



## Plot myeloid cells

## Plot ASPC and mesothelial cells

Figure 4C

SpatialColors <- colorRampPalette(colors = rev(x = brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "Spectral")))

p1 <- SpatialFeaturePlot(object = depots_STx, features = c("famC01_score"), min.cutoff = "q01", max.cutoff = "q99",  image.alpha = 0, images = "V10B01_134_C1")[[1]] +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = SpatialColors(n = 100)[51:1])
## Scale for fill is already present.
## Adding another scale for fill, which will replace the existing scale.
p2 <- SpatialFeaturePlot(object = depots_STx, features = c("Plasma_cell_score"), min.cutoff = "q01", max.cutoff = "q99",  image.alpha = 0, images = "V10B01_134_C1")[[1]] +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = SpatialColors(n = 100)[51:1])
## Scale for fill is already present.
## Adding another scale for fill, which will replace the existing scale.
p1 + p2
